Details

This white co-ord set is crafted in Tencel twill fabric, a soft, breathable fabric made from wood pulp, chosen for its fluid drape and mindful impact. Designed with interchangeable collars, each detail offers a distinct expression of style. Wear it without a collar for a clean mandarin collar look. Add the shirt collar for a classic, structured feel. Or replace it with the delicate lace collar when you want something softer and more feminine. Finished with embroidered buttons and detachable sleeves that can be worn as 3/4-length or full sleeves, this set shifts effortlessly with your mood and moment. One co-ord. Many identities. Because true style is meant to evolve with you. Wear it your way. Wear it with purpose.
